title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Third Civil Trial Division of the Court Being Externally Referred to as the "Intellectual Property Trial Division"
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Civil Adjudication Tribunal No. 3 of This Court Being Externally Referred to as the "Intellectual Property Adjudication Tribunal"

Fa Fa [2006] No. 14

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In accordance with the needs of trial work, and with the approval of the Office of the Central Organization Establishment Commission, the Civil Adjudication Tribunal No. 3 of the Supreme People's Court shall be externally referred to as the "Intellectual Property Adjudication Tribunal of the Supreme People's Court." Local people's courts at all levels that have established intellectual property adjudication work organizations are requested to refer to this notice for handling.

This notice is hereby given.

June 5, 2006
